Apple has just announced that it will hold a "Welcome Home" special event next week, but the good news keeps coming. According to the latest report from Bloomberg, Apple will launch its first MacBook Pro with a touchscreen, an all-new iPad mini, and more "on or around Tuesday, October 27."

The report states that the announcement will include "an online video introduction along with an in-person component for the press to attend."

Apple's second event of the month is scheduled for October 27

The lineup of new products for the late-October announcement includes the following:

  • Brand-new 14-inch and 16-inch touchscreen MacBook Pro models with OLED displays. Both new MacBook Pros will also feature Dynamic Island for the first time, and will be "noticeably lighter" than current models. This batch is expected to be powered by M5 Pro and M5 Max chips.
  • An all-new iPad mini with an OLED display, a repositioned front-facing FaceTime camera, and an "improved speaker system."
  • An all-new iMac powered by the M6 chip, as well as an entry-level 14-inch MacBook Pro model, with designs that will "remain the same as current versions."

Bloomberg notes that the announcement will be "aimed at creative professionals who work in video production, photo editing, and music production." The report compares it to Apple's Mac lineup announcement in October 2024, when the company also hosted a hands-on session in Los Angeles for select media.

It's becoming increasingly clear that Apple has a slew of new products ready to go this month. Which one are you most looking forward to seeing? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
